description: Allowlisted MCP server endpoints that agents may connect to. Stored as a policy file in S3 under the policies/ prefix for runtime reads without redeployment.

allowedEndpoints.name: PSD District MCP Server
allowedEndpoints.description: Internal district MCP server for Google Workspace delegation and district APIs

allowedEndpoints.name: PSD Public Records (PRR) MCP Server
allowedEndpoints.description: Hosted MCP for the district Public Records system. Called only from the AI Studio web tier (executePrrOperation, operation prr-mcp) with each caller's own personal access token (credential slot prr_pat); the agent runtime never connects to it directly.
